name: Saturating Sutures makes periodic damage refund the next Sanguine Mend (#1912)
contract: Saturating Sutures 504098's single effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL (aura 42) on Saturating Sutures 504137, a native aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints -101 and EffectSpellClassMask (524288, 0, 0) - exactly the nine Sanguine Mend ranks. Spell.dbc gives 504098 ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row existed, so the aura was inert. The tooltip is 'Your periodic damage and healing has a $h% chance to reduce the cost of your next Sanguine Mend by $504137s1%' and the record's own ProcChance is 15. Crimson Tide is cast as rank 504134, the rank a level-80 character owns per AscensionSpellProgressionData.h. Its single effect is aura 3 SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE with Amplitude 3000, DurationIndex 8 (15 s) and MaxAffectedTargets 10, so one cast against eight dummies produces 5 ticks x 8 targets = 40 separate PROC_FLAG_DONE_PERIODIC events, and two casts 15 s apart produce about 80. At 15% per event, the chance that none of roughly 80 events procs is 0.85^80, under one in 400000, so no statistical test is needed and the real proc chance is left untouched. 504137 lasts 8 s (DurationIndex 31) and every further proc refreshes it, so it is still up at the assertion.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
No cost reduction before any tick
Five ticks on every dummy in range
DISCRIMINATING: periodic damage granted the Sanguine Mend discount
